text:
Maya: Heads-up: vendor pen-test inbound next Tue. Assessor: BlackHarbor. Scope: staging API, auth service, audit log pipeline. Proposed window: 2026-04-07 10:00-14:00 UTC. Flag any process gaps.
Ethan: I'll take on assessor ops. Two immediate asks: 1) precise ephemeral role policy, 2) sanitized telemetry export process.
Priya: Staging deployed env var that leaks internal IDs in traces. We should scrub before sharing. I'll prepare a scrub runbook.
Sam: From infra side we prefer not to share CMKs. Proposal: use envelope decryption service that writes plaintext to a protected S3 path and emits a signed manifest. No key material leaves.
Maya: Good. Also need an auditable chain-of-custody. Recommend we sign the manifest with our intra-team signing key and include SHA256 hashes.
Ethan: Agree. Draft manifest format: ```
manifest_version: 1
items: [ {path: s3://sec-evidence/pt-blackharbor/1762027689/logs.tar.gz, sha256: <hex>, timestamp: 2026-04-07T10:32:00Z} ]
signature: <JWS>
```
Priya: Will the signing JWS be created by KMS-proxy or by a CI job? We should avoid adding new long-lived creds.
Sam: KMS-proxy can create short-lived signing tokens via EKM. We'll wrap the JWS in the ticket. No persistent keys.
sec-bot: New intake created: JIRA-SEC-4907 (PenTest BlackHarbor) - https://jira.example/SEC-4907
Maya: Excellent. Triage plan: within 24h of report, tag P1/P2 and assign an owner. We should commit to retest within 10 business days for P1 fixes. Vendor requested retest slot within 2 weeks.
Ethan: Can we automate retest gating? I propose a small CI job that runs the exploit verification harness against a staging snapshot and reports pass/fail to JIRA. If pass, we schedule retest slot.
Priya: That harness will need sanitized data. I'll generate a synthetic trace generator matching trace shapes but no PII.
Sam: Regarding RBAC: create role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-blackharbor with conditions: SourceIp, aws:RequestTag/pt-id, and aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent. Timebox to 3 hours by default. We'll add a perf-exemption flag for fuzzing.
Maya: Add requirement: any perf-exemption must be approved by eng-sre lead and logged to SEC-4907.
Ethan: Logging: we need to preserve raw audit logs for 30 days off-host, plus an immutable snapshot for 180 days in cold storage. We'll export via export_forensics.sh and upload to S3 Glacier with manifest.
Priya: I'll add scrub step before export. Scrub checklist (short): remove X-User-Email, hash user_id, redact query params with token-like strings.
Sam: For chain-of-custody, we will: 1) produce artifact; 2) compute SHA256; 3) upload to s3://sec-evidence/pt-blackharbor/1762027689/; 4) sign manifest via KMS-proxy; 5) record entry in SEC-4907 + timestamped comment.
Maya: Let's schedule a dry-run on Fri 2026-04-03 15:00 UTC. Dry-run scope: ephemeral role assume, envelope-decrypt workflow, signed manifest, scrubbed export. 30m.
Ethan: I'll provision the ephemeral role and the presigned S3 URL for the dry-run. Command I'll use: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-blackharbor --duration-seconds 10800 --serial-number arn:aws:iam::123456789012:mfa/assessor`
Priya: I'll have the scrub job ready and the synthetic traces seeded.
Sam: I'll wire up KMS-proxy and a CI task `ci/pt/evidence_signer` that returns a JWS. Example: `./ci/evidence_signer --file logs.tar.gz --kms-proxy-url https://kms-proxy.internal/sign`
Maya: Owners and due dates:
- Maya: create SEC-4907 intake, triage template, retest calendar invite (due 2026-04-01 EOD)
- Ethan: create ephemeral role + presigned S3 + dry-run runbook (due 2026-04-03 12:00 UTC)
- Priya: scrub template + synthetic trace generator + export script updates (due 2026-04-03 EOD)
- Sam: KMS-proxy signing endpoint + CI evidence_signer job (due 2026-04-03 18:00 UTC)
Maya: Also note: incident response tabletop requested by security director on retest day to validate escalation. Will invite IR team.
Ethan: One more: vendor asked for a scoped grafana dashboard access during testing. We should not grant direct dashboard access; instead we can produce a read-only snapshot PNG bundle or a time-limited dashboard token scoped to metrics only.
Priya: I'll prepare the dashboard snapshot exporter.
sec-bot: Reminder: All evidence uploads must include manifest and JWS signature. Noncompliant uploads will be rejected.
Maya: If no blockers, I'll set dry-run invite and tag owners in SEC-4907. Please confirm in-thread.
Ethan: Confirmed. I'll start role creation tomorrow.
Priya: Confirmed.
Sam: Confirmed.
Maya: Closing thread. Updates will be in JIRA and the dry-run notes after Fri.
